description_en: Skip the city noise 🌴 Natura Café hides inside a century-old orchard — bamboo structures, a quiet canal, and tropical greens all around. The perfect afternoon escape with a coffee in hand.
description_zh: 不用出城，曼谷就有叢林秘境 🌴 Natura Café 藏在百年果園裡，竹木建築、運河水景、熱帶植物包圍的座位，配一杯咖啡就是最療癒的午後。
address: 9 Thanon Chom Thong, Khwaeng Chom Thong, Khet Chom Thong, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10150, Thailand

name_en: Heng Chun Seng (Sacred Heart Convent School)
name_zh: Heng Chun Seng (Sacred Heart Convent School)
description_en: A 72-year-old gem hiding in Khlong Toei 🍲 Wang Chun Seng's charcoal hot pot is the real deal — rich broth, tender offal, and old-school flavors that locals have been lining up for since breakfast.
description_zh: 曼谷 Khlong Toei 藏著一家 72 年老店 🍲 王春盛的炭爐牛雜火鍋，湯頭濃郁帶古早甜味，牛肚牛筋燉得軟嫩入味，早上七點就開門，連本地人都排隊來報到。
address: เลขที่ 8/28 Sunthonkosa Rd, Khwaeng Khlong Tan, Khet Khlong Toei, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: A cozy Korean corner on Surawong 🥩 San Nae Deul is run by a hands-on Korean owner who grills the meat for you — the pork belly is tender, the sundubu-jjigae is among Bangkok's best, and the whole meal feels like dinner at a friend's home.
description_zh: 藏在蘇拉旺街角的韓式小館 🥩 San Nae Deul 由韓國老闆親自顧爐，五花肉嫩而不柴，純豆腐鍋被封為曼谷最好吃之一，像在韓國朋友家吃飯一樣暖。
address: 1 7 Soi Ekkamai 2, Khwaeng Phra Khanong Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Not just a café — it's a six-floor coffee world ☕🌿 Café Amazon Experience sits right next to Ari BTS, with a bakery, matcha bar, co-working space, and rooftop views over the BTS line. Thailand's most familiar coffee brand, completely reimagined.
description_zh: 不只是咖啡廳，是六層樓的咖啡體驗 ☕🌿 Café Amazon Experience 就在 Ari BTS 旁，從烘焙坊、抹茶吧到共享辦公室，每層都有不同世界，頂樓還能俯瞰 BTS 軌道與城市天際線。
address: Ari Doi St., Khwaeng Samsen Nai, Khet Phaya Thai, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

description_en: Competition-grade Geisha coffee for just 85 baht ☕ UNO! Coffee sits quietly in CentralWorld's office zone — one of Bangkok's trendiest new spots making the world's most prized beans surprisingly easy on the wallet.
description_zh: 世界頂級藝妓咖啡，在這裡只要 85 元 ☕ UNO! Coffee 藏在 CentralWorld 辦公室區，用平價讓你喝到競賽級的 Geisha Panama，開門前就有人排隊，上午來最安全。
address: The Offices At Central World ชั้น, 1 Rama I Rd, Khwaeng Pathum Wan, Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330, Thailand

description_en: Singaporean friends say it rivals the best back home 🍚 Muek Mun Kai is a tiny shophouse tucked in a quiet soi — silky Hainanese chicken, five bold dipping sauces, and rice from just 69 baht. Come before lunch or risk missing out.
description_zh: 新加坡朋友說比新加坡還好吃 🍚 Muek Mun Kai 藏在小巷裡，嫩滑白斬雞配五種沾醬，一碗才 69 銖，午後就賣完，要來要趁早。
address: 47/1 Soi Phetchaburi 5, Khwaeng Thung Phaya Thai, Khet Ratchathewi, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

description_en: A glass-house hideaway tucked in Ekkamai 🌿 A Keen House is a converted three-storey townhouse with Scandi-minimal meets wabi-sabi vibes — natural light, curated corners, and creative drinks like the Date Cream Latte. The kind of café you stumble upon and keep coming back to.
description_zh: Ekkamai 巷弄裡的玻璃屋咖啡廳 🌿 A Keen House 由三層老街屋改建而成，北歐簡約混日式侘寂，自然光灑進玻璃溫室座位，配一杯 Date Cream Latte，安靜得像個秘密。
address: 4 Soi Sukjai Sukhumvit 40, Khwaeng Phra Khanong, Khet Khlong Toei, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: The perfect after-work unwind 🔥 Ekamai Mookata hides down Soi Ekkamai 24 — open-air garden, live Thai music, and a sizzling charcoal grill loaded with fresh pork. Cold beer, good company, and nowhere else to be.
description_zh: 下班後最想去的那種地方 🔥 Ekamai Mookata 藏在 Ekamai 24 巷，露天庭院配現場泰式音樂，豬肉鮮嫩、湯頭香濃，邊烤邊涮邊喝啤酒，夜晚就該這樣過。
address: 392 Soi Om Sin Sena 3, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

name_en: ครัวพิศมัย
name_zh: ครัวพิศมัย
description_en: A no-frills Isan kitchen tucked in Ratchathewi 🌶️ ครัวพิศมัย serves honest, homestyle northeastern Thai food — bold, spicy, and just the way locals like it. Nothing fancy, everything delicious.
description_zh: 藏在拉差貼威巷弄裡的家常東北菜 🌶️ ครัวพิศมัย 料理樸實不花俏，每一口都是道地的อีสาน味，辣得過癮、鹹得剛好，像在泰國朋友家裡吃飯。
address: 68/36 Soi Phetchaburi 7, Khwaeng Thung Phaya Thai, Khet Ratchathewi, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

name_en: ปิ้งเนย สาขาอนุสาวรีย์ชัยฯ
name_zh: ปิ้งเนย สาขาอนุสาวรีย์ชัยฯ
description_en: All-you-can-eat BBQ on a rooftop with BTS views 🔥 ปิ้งเนย sits on the 5th floor of Victory Hub — 60+ items including Australian beef, fresh seafood, and three types of grills to choose from, all for 339 baht. No time limit, no reason to leave early.
description_zh: 339 銖吃到飽，還附贈曼谷天際線 🔥 ปิ้งเนย 在 Victory Hub 頂樓露天烤肉，俯瞰 BTS 輕軌穿梭而過，牛肉、海鮮、豬肉超過 60 種食材隨你夾，三種爐具自由搭配，不限時間，夜晚就該這樣過。
address: ชั้น 5 Victory Hub 459 Thanon Ratchawithi, Khwaeng Thanon Phaya Thai, Khet Ratchathewi, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

description_en: Step into a quiet Ari lane and suddenly you're in Europe 🥐 Landhaus is Bangkok's most authentic German-Austrian bakery — flour imported from Germany, bread baked fresh daily, and a cozy back garden to enjoy it all. The kind of Saturday morning you didn't know you needed.
description_zh: 走進 Ari 小巷，彷彿瞬間飛到歐洲 🥐 Landhaus 是曼谷最道地的德奧麵包坊，麵粉從德國進口，每天現烤黑麥麵包、椒鹽脆餅與丹麥酥，後院花園配一杯咖啡，週末早晨就該這樣開始。
address: 18 Soi Phahonyothin 5, Khwaeng Samsen Nai, Khet Phaya Thai, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

description_en: The most wholesome afternoon Bangkok has to offer 🐺 TrueLove @ Neverland is a husky café tucked inside an Ari residential lane — home to 30+ fluffy dogs with big personalities. Two sessions daily, limited spots, arrive early or the huskies won't wait.
description_zh: 曼谷最療癒的下午，是和哈士奇一起度過的 🐺 TrueLove @ Neverland 藏在 Ari 住宅巷裡，30 隻哈士奇等你來玩，每天兩場限時入場，建議提早到，牠們可比你更受歡迎。
address: 153 Soi Ari Samphan 2, Phaya Thai, Khet Phaya Thai, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

description_en: Skip the trip to Chiang Mai — Ari's got you covered 🍜 Ongtong Khaosoi is a Michelin-recommended gem serving northern Thai flavours with ingredients sourced fresh from Chiang Mai. Creamy curry broth, tender stewed beef, and a signature chrysanthemum milk to wash it all down.
description_zh: 不用去清邁，在 Ari 就能吃到道地北部麵 🍜 Ongtong Khaosoi 榮獲米其林推薦，食材直送自清邁，咖哩湯頭濃郁香滑，燉牛肉軟嫩入味，再配一杯招牌菊花鮮奶，北部風味一次滿足。
address: 31 Phahonyothin Soi 7, Phaya Thai, Khet Phaya Thai, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

name_en: Roasted Honey Glazed Pork Mae Sumontha
name_zh: Roasted Honey Glazed Pork Mae Sumontha
description_en: The one stall worth getting lost in Chatuchak for 🍖 Mae Sumontha's honey glazed roasted pork is market legend — juicy, perfectly balanced sweet and savory, best enjoyed with a steamy bao bun or sticky rice. Follow the smell and you'll find it.
description_zh: 週末逛恰圖恰，必繞路來找這攤 🍖 แม่สุมณฑา 的蜂蜜烤豬已是市場傳奇，豬肉鮮嫩多汁、甜鹹恰到好處，配上熱騰騰的刈包或糯米飯，光是香味就讓人走不動腿。
address: 587 โครงการ 22 ซอย 4 /2ตลาดนัด จตุจักร 10 Kamphaeng Phet 2 Rd, Khwaeng Chatuchak, Khet Chatuchak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10900, Thailand

name_en: เจียงฮวา 江花 Charm ｜เสี่ยวหลงเปา ข้าวหมูพะโล้ และอาหารไต้หวันแท้
name_zh: เจียงฮวา 江花 Charm ｜เสี่ยวหลงเปา ข้าวหมูพะโล้ และอาหารไต้หวันแท้
description_en: A little taste of Taiwan in the heart of Bangkok 🍚 Jiang Hua is a home away from home for Taiwanese expats — and the braised pork rice is the star. One bite of that glossy, slow-cooked lu rou fan and homesickness disappears completely.
description_zh: 身在曼谷，心回台灣 🍚 江花台灣料理是異鄉遊子的秘密基地，一碗滷肉飯端上桌，油亮的肉燥香氣四溢，那個味道不用多說，就是家的感覺。
address: Chok Chai 4 Soi 28, Khwaeng Lat Phrao, Khet Lat Phrao, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10230, Thailand

description_en: Plant-based never felt this good 🌱 Tucked in Soi Sukhumvit 36, VIBE Coffee is a bright, airy café with floor-to-ceiling windows and a menu that makes even meat-lovers rethink everything — vegan satay, moo ping, Thai and Western dishes, all done right.
description_zh: 吃素不將就 🌱 VIBE Coffee 藏在 Thonglor 巷弄裡，落地窗採光明亮、空間舒適，植物肉沙嗲、烤豬串通通有素食版，連肉食主義者也說驚艷，配一杯阿拉比卡咖啡，身心都舒暢。
address: 118 สุขุมวิท 36 Soi Saen Sabai, Khwaeng Phra Khanong, Khet Phra Khanong, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Bangkok's most fragrant basement find 🌿 BOTANICESSENCE at M-Square Plaza is an essential oil lover's dream — a vast selection of pure oils, knowledgeable staff, and the kind of sensory experience that makes you linger far longer than planned.
description_zh: 曼谷最香的地下室 🌿 BOTANICESSENCE 藏在 M-Square Plaza 地下樓，超過百種純天然精油任你聞，專業又親切的店員帶你找到最對味的那瓶，香氛迷的朝聖地。
address: M-Square Plaza, B1 Floor, Maleenont Tower, Khwaeng Khlong Tan, Klong-Toey Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: The Chinese comfort food Bangkok didn't know it needed 🥟 Tucked in Soi Sukhumvit 41 near BTS Phrom Phong, Tong Lai Sun is a no-frills gem beloved by locals and expats alike — soup dumplings, spicy boiled beef, and wok-fried rice that genuinely taste like home.
description_zh: 在曼谷吃到讓人想家的中國菜 🥟 東來順藏在蓬蓬巷弄裡，湯包皮薄汁多、水煮牛肉鮮辣下飯、炒飯鑊氣十足，氛圍樸實溫暖，是當地人和日僑下班後最愛報到的那種地方。
address: 2/52 Soi Sukhumvit 41, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Worth every minute of the wait 🥩 Kobe Tonteki sits right across from Emsphere on Soi 33/1 — their sous vide pork steak is melt-in-your-mouth tender, topped with a rich signature sauce, and comes with unlimited rice, miso soup, and pickles. Simple, satisfying, and very hard to stop at one serving.
description_zh: 曼谷最值得排隊的豬排飯 🥩 Kobe Tonteki 就在 Emsphere 對面，招牌豬排以舒肥慢煮，嫩到入口即化，搭上秘製醬汁、白飯味噌湯無限續，一吃就明白為什麼要等位。
address: 595, 3-4 Soi Sukhumvit 33/1, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Bangkok's most charming Thai restaurant 🌿 Taling Pling on Sukhumvit 34 is the owner's converted childhood home — think tropical garden, a koi pond, and lush greenery all around. The food is as beautiful as the setting: classic Thai recipes done with real care, and a massaman curry that's hard to forget.
description_zh: 曼谷最像「家」的泰式餐廳 🌿 Taling Pling 藏在素坤逸 34 巷，前身是老闆的兒時故居，熱帶花園、魚池、百年老宅，綠意環繞中吃上一份瑪莎曼咖哩或芒果糯米飯，是曼谷最值得特地跑一趟的泰菜之一。
address: 25 Soi Sukhumvit 34, Khwaeng Khlong Tan, Khet Khlong Toei, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Bangkok's favourite weekend brunch hideaway ☕ Folk Lane by Toby's is tucked deep in Sukhumvit 38 — red brick walls, a leafy terrace, and a menu full of brunch classics done beautifully. Smashed avo, eggs benedict, specialty coffee — the kind of morning you don't want to rush.
description_zh: 曼谷最療癒的週末早午餐 ☕ Folk Lane by Toby's 藏在素坤逸 38 巷深處，紅磚老屋、綠意露台，酪梨吐司、水波蛋早餐盤搭配一杯精品咖啡，假日早上最值得特地跑一趟的地方。
address: 75 Soi Santi Suk, Khwaeng Phra Khanong, Khet Khlong Toei, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: The Korean expat secret hiding in Ekamai 🍜 Bangkok Banjom is a no-frills gem inside the Horizon building on Sukhumvit 63 — serving authentic Korean-Chinese classics like jajangmyeon and jjamppong that even Korean locals swear by. Unpretentious, satisfying, and genuinely hard to find elsewhere in Bangkok.
description_zh: 曼谷韓僑的秘密食堂 🍜 Bangkok Banjom 藏在 Ekamai 的 Horizon 大樓裡，專攻道地韓式中華料理，炸醬麵Q彈醬香、海鮮炒碼麵鮮辣夠味，是韓國人自己也愛來的那種小館。
address: Thailand, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon, Soi Sukhumvit 63, Horizon Eakkamai

description_en: Morning café, midnight bar — all in one spot 🎶 The Office Thonglor is a laid-back community space on Soi 63, with indoor and outdoor seating, specialty coffee, brunch plates, and live music after dark. Pet-friendly, open late, and the kind of place that works for any mood.
description_zh: 白天是咖啡廳，晚上變酒吧 🎶 The Office Thonglor 是通羅巷弄裡的多功能共享空間，室內室外座位開闊舒適，白天配一杯 Biscuit Latte 安靜工作，入夜後現場樂團接手，連毛小孩都歡迎入場。
address: 125/1 Soi Sukhumvit 63, 117/1 ถ. ทองหล่อ แขวงคลองตันเหนือ เขตวัฒนา กรุงเทพมหานคร 10110, Thailand

description_en: Tokyo's most iconic cheesecake, now in Thonglor 🧀 Jerome Cheesecake is the brainchild of a former three-Michelin-starred chef — burnt Basque cheesecake made with Hokkaido dairy and rare Spanish Basque cheese. Caramelized on the outside, melt-in-your-mouth silky inside. Worth every baht.
description_zh: 不用飛東京，在通羅就能吃到 🧀 Jerome Cheesecake 出自前三星米其林主廚之手，北海道鮮奶油搭配西班牙巴斯克起司，表面焦香、內裡入口即化，每一口都像是甜點界的藝術品。
address: ชั้น1 Market Place Thonglor ศูนย์การค้า มาร์เก็ต เพลส เลขที่ 323 Soi Thong Lo, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

name_en: BARTELS Asok - Sourdough Sandwiches, Coffee & Juicery
name_zh: BARTELS Asok - Sourdough Sandwiches, Coffee & Juicery
description_en: The best morning in Bangkok starts here 🥖 BARTELS Asok bakes fresh sourdough throughout the day — never older than three hours. Scandinavian-minimal vibes, a killer sandwich menu, cold-pressed juices, and a second floor where you can watch the bread come out of the oven. The kind of breakfast spot you'll keep coming back to.
description_zh: 曼谷最香的早晨從這裡開始 🥖 BARTELS Asok 每天現烤酸麵包、絕不超過三小時，北歐簡約空間裡，一份 Fig Toast 或煙燻火腿三明治配上一杯拿鐵，還能從二樓看著麵包出爐，療癒指數破表。
address: 199/9-11 Sukhumvit Rd, Khwaeng Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

name_en: The Living Room at Baan Trok Tua Ngork
name_zh: The Living Room at Baan Trok Tua Ngork
description_en: A century-old family home, reborn in Chinatown 🏚️ The Living Room sits on the 4th floor of Baan Trok Tua Ngork — a 1920s heritage building lovingly restored by four siblings. Lush greenery, vintage furniture, rooftop views over old Bangkok, and a calm that's rare to find in the city. A destination for those who appreciate beauty with a story.
description_zh: 唐人街巷弄裡的百年老宅新生 🏚️ The Living Room 藏在 Baan Trok Tua Ngork 四樓，1920 年代古厝由四兄妹親手修繕，綠植與老傢俱交織出時光靜止的氛圍，俯瞰老曼谷屋頂，一杯咖啡配一段往事。
address: Pom Prap, Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

description_en: A canal-side retreat hidden near Siam 🌿 Baan Saen Saep is a wooden house café wrapped in trees and flowers along the Saen Saep Canal — live music, a resident cat, and freshly baked cakes daily. Calm, charming, and the kind of place that makes Bangkok feel like a small town.
description_zh: 鬧市裡的心靈綠洲 🌿 Baan Saen Saep 就在 Siam 附近的運河邊，木造老屋被花草與樹木環繞，有現場音樂、有貓、有每天新鮮現做的蛋糕，像在朋友家客廳消磨一個下午，早上六點開門，比誰都準時。
address: 20 2 Rama I Rd, Khwaeng Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330, Thailand

name_en: ร้านฮ๊อทพ๊อทหอยย๊า
name_zh: ร้านฮ๊อทพ๊อทหอยย๊า
description_en: Thailand's original flaming clam hot pot 🔥🦪 ฮ๊อทพ๊อทหอยย๊า on Lat Phrao Wang Hin is one of a kind — fresh clams and seafood cooked in a dramatic tableside flame show, paired with a killer dipping sauce. One location only, so it's worth making the trip.
description_zh: 泰國首創！每桌都有火焰秀的貝類火鍋 🔥🦪 ฮ๊อทพ๊อทหอยย๊า 在拉差達藏了好久，新鮮蛤蜊、海鮮配上獨門海鮮醬，每道上桌都伴隨火焰噴發，好吃又好拍，只有這一家分店，想吃就得特地來。
address: 617 หมู่ 11 ลาดพร้าง, Khwaeng Lat Phrao, Khet Lat Phrao, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10230, Thailand

description_en: Bangkok's best shot at a real Neapolitan pizza 🍕 Peppina's Sukhumvit flagship on Soi 33 is the one that started it all — wood-fired, perfectly charred crusts, quality Italian ingredients, and a lively atmosphere that fills up fast. The truffle pizza and vongole linguine are worth every baht. Book ahead.
description_zh: 曼谷最道地的那不勒斯披薩 🍕 Peppina 旗艦店藏在素坤逸 33 巷，木柴窯現烤、餅皮酥脆帶焦香，松露披薩與蛤蜊義大利麵都是必點，熱鬧得晚上常常一位難求，記得提前訂位。
address: 27/1 Soi Sukhumvit 33, Khwaeng Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Bangkok's most fun bar concept 🎲 Truth or Dare takes over an entire floor of The Duchess Hotel in Langsuan — live band outside, DJ inside, cocktails named after the game itself, and unlimited popcorn all night. The kind of place where the night always goes somewhere unexpected. Book a table on weekends.
description_zh: 曼谷最會玩的酒吧就在這裡 🎲 Truth or Dare 佔據 The Duchess Hotel 一整層，室外有現場樂團與撞球桌，室內 DJ 越夜越燃，雞尾酒單直接以「Truth」和「Dare」命名，爆米花無限供應，週末必訂位。
address: 61 Lang Suan Rd, Khwaeng Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330, Thailand

description_en: Bangkok's most beloved Thai-Chinese comfort food, elevated 🦆 Rongsi Pochana sits inside the elegant Velaa Sindhorn Village on Langsuan — slow-braised five-spice duck, yellow chili crab, and crispy oyster omelette, all rooted in generations-old recipes. Traditional flavours, modern setting, and always worth booking ahead.
description_zh: 潮州家常菜裡的曼谷頂流 🦆 Rongsi Pochana 藏在 Velaa Sindhorn Village，五香滷鴨嫩而入味、黃咖哩炒螃蟹鮮香濃郁、生蠔煎酥脆焦香，老食譜遇上精緻擺盤，每道都像外婆的味道升級版。
address: ห้องเลขที่ B107เลขที่ 87 Soi Langsuan, Khwaeng Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330, Thailand

name_en: Just A Drink Maybe - Bagel Coffee Shop
name_zh: Just A Drink Maybe - Bagel Coffee Shop
description_en: New York bagel energy, hidden in Silom 🥯 Just A Drink Maybe handcrafts every bagel from scratch daily — chewy inside, crisp outside, with house-made cream cheese that steals the show. Quiet, spacious, fast WiFi, and open early. The kind of spot you find once and keep coming back to.
description_zh: 矽隆巷弄裡的紐約靈魂 🥯 Just A Drink Maybe 每天手工現烤貝果，外酥內Q、自製奶油起司每日新鮮，Smoked Salmon、火腿蛋隨你搭，空間安靜寬敞附快速 WiFi，是晨間工作咖的秘密基地。
address: 37 Soi Silom 9, Si Lom, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

description_en: A time capsule of southern-style Thai-Chinese comfort food 🍜 Chan Charoen on Chan Road is all jade-green tiles and 1970s charm — their braised pork leg over rice is slow-cooked, rich, and deeply satisfying. Simple, affordable, and the kind of place that keeps locals coming back every week.
description_zh: 仿若走進 70 年代中國的翠綠小館 🍜 Chan Charoen 就在 Chan Road 上，招牌南派豬腳飯湯頭濃郁、肉質軟嫩，搭上廣東麵條更是一絕，復古磁磚牆面超上鏡，樸實又道地，是曼谷老饕的私藏口袋名單。
address: 264 22-23 Thanon Chan, Khwaeng Wat Phraya Krai, Khet Bang Kho Laem, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10120, Thailand

description_en: Three generations of Bangkok's best crispy pork 🐷 Kuay Jab Mr. Joe on Chan Road is a Michelin-recognised gem — deeply peppery pork broth, silky rolled rice noodles, and crispy pork belly with skin that actually crunches. Cheap, no-frills, and worth setting your alarm for. Opens at 7:30am.
description_zh: 曼谷最強脆皮豬，傳承三代五十年 🐷 Mr. Joe 的粿汁湯頭濃郁帶胡椒香，脆皮豬腩外酥內嫩、一口下去爆汁，米其林掛名卻依然平價，早上七點半開門，建議趁早來報到。
address: 313/7 Thanon Chan, Khwaeng Wat Phraya Krai, Khet Bang Kho Laem, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10120, Thailand

description_en: Riverside mookata with the best view in Bangkok 🔥 Everyday Mookrata sits right along the Chao Phraya River — grill your pork and seafood while boats drift past, live music plays in the background, and the city lights reflect off the water. The kind of evening you won't want to end.
description_zh: 河邊烤肉的夜晚，沒有比這更對了 🔥 Everyday Mookrata Riverside 就坐落在昭披耶河畔，看著船來船往、微風吹過，一邊炭烤豬肉海鮮、一邊配現場音樂，曼谷夜晚最放鬆的方式就是這樣。
address: 23 ซอย โรงน้ำแข็ง Khwaeng Talat Noi, Khet Samphanthawong, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10100, Thailand
